title: Boku no Hero Academia Original Eiga Manner Kouza
content:
I have come to enjoy these in recent years. There are more like gambling, but the only catch is a few seconds lost.

Of course Bakugo would be the bad, frowned upon example of how theatre annoyances would be personified, but man, they just had to have Shoto there acting like a behaving kid. I must say, they got that one on brand. And of course, Deku with his loud anxiety that can trigger Bakugo on command, but that one’s on him. They could not have featured a better, more suitable trio for this than them lol.

I really loved the comic book art style for this, the dialogue was tame but humorous. Definitely not for hype’s sake but absolutely it was mood setting.

Overall: 5.8/10.
